message: I was tidying up my pantry the other day and found some old supplies I’d forgotten about. It got me thinking about how preparing for emergencies can actually feel a bit like planning for a cozy family gathering. 🥰 Having a well-stocked kit means you’re ready to hunker down together, sharing stories and snacks while the world whirls outside. It’s all about turning a potentially stressful situation into a chance for connection. Have you thought about what you might include in your own cozy setup?
